import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtSeparated
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
-- MINIMALITY, restated as the exact theorem with both binders DROPPED
theorem lft_of_baseChange_anyExt {k : Type u} [Field k] (k' : Type u)
    [Field k'] [Algebra k k'] {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (h : LocallyOfFiniteType
      (Limits.pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) X.hom)) :
    LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom :=
  locallyOfFiniteType_of_baseChange k' h
